what_this_is: The cutter's default numbers: common editing and online-video norms, and the measuring steps of the cutter itself. A request's "rules" are laid over these key by key, so a cut changes one number without restating the rest. Nothing here is a look or a style: those come in the request's looks and devices.

frame.why: every picture piece is cut at this rate with frame-exact counts; the frame size is the plan's own aspect

audio.why: -16 LUFS and -1.5 dBTP are the common online-video loudness; each spoken span is brought to piece_lufs (gain held to piece_gain_db, measured on the span as heard) and limited at limit, the whole mix gets one two-pass linear loudnorm, and an edge with no crossfade fades over edge_fade_s so it does not click

edges.why: an edge takes at most handle_s beyond from/to, and less when the neighbouring word is closer (kept safety_s clear), so no cut catches the word before or after; two recorded spans that follow each other cross-fade over crossfade_frames (never under crossfade_min_s) and the picture cuts halfway; a span after a held frame starts speech_lead_s before its first word

shot_match.why: each video span is measured on samples frames (edge_s in from its ends; one middle frame when shorter than min_span_s) and moved to the cut's pooled L*a*b* statistics by strength

hold.why: eye and mouth openness are height/width ratios of the face reader's landmarks: a held frame has open eyes and a closed mouth, near the next span's first frame, the window widening by these multiples of search_s while the best one still differs from that frame by more than match_diff (mean grey, 0-255, at 240x135); a held frame from another moment dissolves into its span over dissolve_frames so the picture does not jump

placement.why: graphics keep face_pad_px clear of the face (read on face_frames frames); when both sides are clear the calmer one wins: least motion in a box x_px wide at each side, from the tag's height down tag_sizes_tall tag sizes, read at width x height and fps

graphics.why: the columns a plan graphic covers are measured on transparent stills at these shares of its own time
